Title: Design Basis
Text: SCA-002 admits PRD v0.2 as the working product-design basis for OpenPipeStress. The amendment changes the product framing from a narrower open piping stress analysis platform toward an analysis-grade piping design engine and stress-model authoring environment with a full internal solver, schema-backed physical model, immutable model states, analysis runs, deterministic comparison, and handoff packages.  The PRD v0.2 basis does not reduce solver seriousness. It preserves the full analytical engine, open mechanics/private code-data boundary, unit safety, rule-pack structure, validation discipline, local-first posture, and professional responsibility boundary.
